item.title: New owners take over The Swan in South Wootton
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
New owners take over The Swan in South Wootton
The Swan pub in South Wootton has been taken over by new management. The venue, which had previously closed due to what were described as incredibly challenging times, will now operate as a sister pub to The Crossways in Lynn.
New owners Michelle and Justin have officially taken over the reins of the business. This follows the departure of previous publicans Jay Hudson and Maggie Hodgkiss, who had been running the establishment since May. Despite an encouraging start to their time at the pub, the former operators cited difficult trading conditions as the reason for their decision to step down.

item.description:

Looking back at 2014 student visit from North West Norfolk MP
We are looking back at a visit to St Clement’s High School in Terrington during November 2014. As part of Parliament Week, GCSE Citizenship students held a question-and-answer session with the then North West Norfolk MP, Henry Bellingham.
During the event, the Year 11 pupils questioned the MP on several topics, including the proposed Lynn incinerator. The students also sought Mr Bellingham’s views on whether teenagers aged 16 and 17 should be granted the right to vote. The session provided an opportunity for the young people to engage directly with their local representative.

item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
Nominations closing for 2027 West Norfolk Mayor’s Business Awards
Time is running out for businesses to enter the 2027 King’s Lynn and West Norfolk Mayor’s Business Awards. Nominations for the 38th annual event close at 5pm on Friday, November 27. Organisers are currently seeking entries for 11 categories, including the Customer Care award, which is sponsored by My House Agency.
The awards ceremony will be held at the Alive Corn Exchange in King’s Lynn on Friday, March 5. Businesses are permitted to submit nominations in up to two categories. Judges will also select an overall Mayor’s Business of the Year from the category winners, which will be announced during the black-tie event. Further details on how to nominate are available through the Lynn News.

item.description:

Festive events announced at True’s Yard Fisherfolk Museum
True’s Yard Fisherfolk Museum in King’s Lynn is hosting a series of Christmas events after receiving over £2,500 in grant funding. The ‘Reel Bright Idea’ project includes a free Dickensian trail, a Christmas tree exhibition, and various craft sessions. Families can also enjoy a light trail, a carol concert at All Saints’ Church, and a hamper competition.
While many activities are free, some events require advance booking or an entry fee. The museum will also open for special evening sessions in mid-December. For full details on the schedule, including how to book tickets or register for workshops, visit the True’s Yard website, call 01553 770479, or email info@truesyard.co.uk.

item.title: Looking back at local news from November 2013 and 2014
item.description:
📰 FENLAND ANGELS RADIO | LOCAL NEWS
Looking back at local news from November 2013 and 2014
We are taking a look back at stories from across the region during November in 2013 and 2014. Notable events included the 40th anniversary of the Dersingham Scout and Guide headquarters and the 50th anniversary of the North Lynn Methodist Church. In King’s Lynn, the first phase of the Hillington Square regeneration was completed, and the town saw the opening of The Gatehouse pub. Other highlights from the period included the Christmas lights switch-on, fundraising efforts at the Bespak factory for Movember, and the return of a restored World War I medal to a local family. Additionally, the Sandringham Flower Show announced a record donation of £50,000 to various charities.
